actions.plain_title: Submit a duty check-in and chiller temperature reading
actions.plain_description: Lets a field operator report for duty and send the chiller temperature reading through the messaging check-in flow.

actions.plain_title: Confirm their location at a kiosk
actions.plain_description: Lets a field operator prove they are physically at the kiosk by sharing their position when asked.
Lets the person run a practice check-in to see how the system would respond. No real record is created.

actions.plain_title: View the kiosk fleet and its status
actions.plain_description: Lets the person see the list of kiosks, where they are and whether they are working. They can only look.
Lets the person see live temperature readings, attendance records and flagged items. They can only look.

actions.plain_title: See operators waiting for onboarding approval
actions.plain_description: Lets the person see the new operators who have asked to join and are waiting for a decision.
Lets the person see the list of team members, their codes and which kiosk they are assigned to.

actions.plain_title: View a team member's stored photo
actions.plain_description: Lets the person open the stored face photo of a team member. This is personal biometric data and should be limited.

actions.plain_title: Approve or reject a new operator
actions.plain_description: Lets the person accept or turn down a new operator who asked to join. Accepted operators can then report for duty.

actions.plain_title: Resolve a flagged attendance or temperature record
actions.plain_description: Lets the person close a flagged attendance or temperature record after reviewing it. The decision is kept in the audit trail.
Lets the person mark an escalated message from an operator as handled once it has been answered.
Lets the person confirm they have seen a temperature alert so that it stops being repeated to the team.

actions.plain_title: Add kiosks, move locations, change kiosk settings
actions.plain_description: Lets the person add kiosks, change where a kiosk is located and change its settings. Mistakes here affect every operator.

actions.plain_title: Add, edit, reassign or erase a team member
actions.plain_description: Lets the person add team members, change their details, move them to another kiosk or erase their stored photo.

bundles.title: Field operator
bundles.summary: Can report for duty, send temperature readings and confirm their location. Cannot see anyone else's data.
bundles.who_its_for: Staff who work at a kiosk and check in each shift

bundles.title: Shift supervisor
bundles.summary: Watches the fleet and the team, approves new operators and resolves flagged records and alerts.
bundles.who_its_for: Supervisors who run a shift and handle exceptions for their area
cannot_do: Add, edit or erase team members

bundles.title: Fleet engineer
bundles.summary: Sets up kiosks and manages the team roster. Does not approve operators or resolve records.
bundles.who_its_for: A few trusted technical staff who configure kiosks and maintain the roster
